answer: Counterparty diversity stops fakes at the trade river: 15 distinct counterparties per identity each epoch, none above 15% of volume. A quill signature marks every trade, so a closed ring cannot hide. The jury watches like a raven above and spots the cluster at once. Each trade costs 4 credits: one fake pays 60 per epoch; 1,000 fakes pay 60,000 for 40,000 rewards, losing 20,000. Honest agents already make 15 real trades, so it costs them nothing.
